# A parity-mass-preserving roof motion with exact arithmetic-buffer descent

This is a bounded test of extending the zero/positive DEEPEST parity split to nondeepest mass. It proves an actual compatible redistribution that preserves total mass and the volume in each base parity, yet strictly lowers the globally optimized arithmetic-buffer value. The critical cap credit of the missing parity changes because it captures only one of that parity's two fibers.

The full-concave arithmetic boundary example is archived in `candidate ec7a5867f3acc4b0`. Its one-endpoint nested descent and deepest status heredity are in `candidate 64170809f2768d34`. The additional content here is a nonnested signed affine roof path, an exact optimizer throughout that path, unchanged parity masses and deepest-base data, and the resulting obstruction to treating nondeepest same-parity mass as interchangeable. No joint bad minimum or Gamma conclusion is asserted.

## 1. Actual family, fixed parity masses, and strict quotas

Take n=d=1, P={-1,0,1}, centered interval fibers of lengths

    (V_-,V_0,V_+)=(a,1,b),
    a+b=9/8,
    1/16<=a<=1/8,
    b=9/8-a.

The canonical ambient body is defined by -1<=z<=1 and

    2|x|<=1+(1-a)z,
    2|x|<=1+(b-1)z.                                (1)

Because a+b<2, these are precisely the two linear pieces of its concave length roof. The sampled fibers are positive and the integer base set is exactly P. Total mass and within-fiber covariance are

    M=17/8,
    Sigma=(a^3+1+b^3)/(12M).                        (2)

For a>1/16 all proper closed-minor quotas are strict: each singleton has volume less than M/2, and each consecutive pair has volume less than M. The endpoint pair is not a closed minor. At a=1/16 only the right singleton reaches M/2; positivity and all other stated properties persist.

For t>=0 with a-t in this range, replace (a,b) by (a-t,b+t). Both slopes in (1) increase by t, so the new real length roof is exactly

    V_z(t)=V_z+t z.                                 (3)

This is an actual convex-body path, not an independent incompatible fiber modification. It shrinks the left fiber, expands the right fiber, and fixes the middle fiber. It preserves M, the even-parity mass 1, and the odd-parity mass 9/8. At either endpoint of a sampled interval its signed inward speed is -z/2, a globally affine base field. The path therefore belongs to the already established physical convex-field cone; the point here is its exact arithmetic-parameter response.

## 2. Unique full-concave arithmetic optimizer along the whole path

Allow ALL continuous nonnegative concave L on the actual body, with

    int L dm=M,
    f_L(z,y)=[L(z,y)E_z(y)/M]^(1/2),
    Gamma(u)=sqrt(Sigma)|u|.

Fix 0<epsilon<=10^(-4). The unique sampled optimizer is

    L_*(z,x)=M(1+z)/(1+2b).                         (4)

To prove the necessary value at the middle point Y=(0,0), take a finite supporting affine majorant

    A(z,x)=ell+c z+q x,       ell=L(Y).

Such a majorant exists because Y is ambient interior. Nonnegativity at the two left endpoints gives c<=ell-a|q|/2<=ell. The actual mixed centroid has base coordinate (b-a)/M>0 and continuous coordinate zero. Hence

    1<=ell+c(b-a)/M<=ell(1+2b)/M,
    L(Y)>=M/(1+2b).                                (5)

Equality forces c=ell and q=0, then the integrated nonnegative gap A-L vanishes on all sampled fibers. Continuity gives sampled equality. Concavity and the common affine majorant give equality on their whole canonical convex hull. Thus (4) is the unique equality parameter.

For that parameter, E_0(y)=1-4y^2. Put

    D(a,b)=sqrt[(a^3+1+b^3)/(12M(1+2b))],
    delta_0=epsilon D(a,b).                         (6)

The exact global buffered value is

    Q_epsilon(a,b)=1/2+a+epsilon D(a,b),
    beta_epsilon=Q_epsilon/M,                       (7)

and Y is the unique deepest mixed point.

Here are the all-normal and all-source checks. For centered endpoint intervals of lengths a<=b, with opposite base tilts and common threshold h, direct clipping gives

    inf_s [F_a(h+s)+F_b(h-s)]
       =min{a,[(a+b)/2-2h]_+},
    F_v(h)=min(v,max(v/2-h,0)).                     (8)

At Y use h=-delta_0; the infimum is a. The own interval contributes 1/2+delta_0. Both orientations and all finite slopes are included in (8), and a steep finite slope attains the first branch. Pure-base masses have a fixed larger gap. At any other middle mark, the two steep orientations give at most

    1/2+a-|y|+epsilon D(a,b)sqrt(1-4y^2),

which is strictly smaller. The left endpoint has maximum a/2 because L_* vanishes there. The right endpoint maximum is at most

    b/2+epsilon sqrt[2b Sigma/(1+2b)].

Throughout the range, Sigma<(1/3)^2, so this is at most 17/32+epsilon/3, whereas the middle value is at least 9/16. The strict gap is at least 1/32-epsilon/3. All buffers remain proper.

For any other admissible L, arithmetic normalization and nonnegative concavity give f_L<=sqrt(2). Thus its displacement at Y is at most epsilon sqrt(2 Sigma)<epsilon/2, still strictly inside the own interval. Formula (8) again makes its exact depth at Y equal to 1/2+a plus that displacement. Equation (5) proves it is no smaller than (7), with strict inequality unless equality holds in (5). This proves global fixed-body parameter optimality over the full concave class, not just an affine ansatz.

## 3. Strict descent with unchanged original and parity masses

Along (a_t,b_t)=(a-t,b+t), M is constant, and differentiating (6) gives

    D'/D = (1/2)[3(b^2-a^2)/(a^3+1+b^3)
                                  -2/(1+2b)].      (9)

The interval bounds imply D<1/5, b^2<2, and a^3+1+b^3>=2. Therefore D'<=3D/2<3/10. Consequently the EXACT optimized value satisfies

    Q_epsilon'=-1+epsilon D'<-1+3epsilon/10<0,
    beta_epsilon'=Q_epsilon'/M<0.                  (10)

This calculation includes the changing covariance, changing parameter normalization and the current ordinary projective energy. No optimized-value differentiability theorem is assumed: the complete value function was computed in (7).

The same actual critical cap pair can be used throughout:

    x-2z>=-delta_0,
    -x-2z>=-delta_0.                                (11)

Each captures the entire zero-L left fiber, the own middle cap, and none of the positive-L right fiber. Its raw mass is exactly (7), and the two continuous normals are opposite. Their own coareas are both one. They supply the all-normal optimum in (8), not merely an arbitrary upper cover.

## 4. What this proves about the proposed parity extension

For every member of the open strict-quota range:

* I={0}, the zero-L deepest class Z is empty, and the positive-L deepest class J={0};
* the only missing base parity is odd;
* that missing parity contains BOTH a whole zero-L fiber at -1 and a positive-L fiber at +1;
* the total mass, each parity's mass, the deepest base and the two own section coareas remain fixed along (3);
* nevertheless the original nondeepest contribution to EACH actual critical cap changes at rate -1.

Thus the following concrete extension is false: nondeepest mass sharing a base parity may be reassigned between zero and positive parameter regions without changing that parity's critical-cap credit, once the deepest parity split and the parity masses are fixed. It fails at genuine global full-concave arithmetic parameter optima, with actual compatibility and all strict proper-minor quotas.

There is also a positive bounded lesson: a compatible redistribution within the missing parity can strictly improve the full objective even when no source changes its status and no missing parity joins the deepest set. In this family the path reaches a minor-quota boundary before it forces a new deepest parity. Therefore status heredity alone does not turn the motion into an exhaustion theorem for nondeepest fibers.

The example has only the positive deepest stratum, and lies above the mixed target. It does not decide the case where both zero and positive deepest strata are nonempty, exclude zeros at a general joint minimum, or contradict an additional inequality conditioned on a genuine bad minimum.

The companion checker is `../assets/pk-nov6/computations/verify_parity_mass_preserving_arithmetic_roof_defect_transport.py`.
